metadata.description: The planning plugin: staged, gate-checked plans for coding agents, built from one core for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Staged, gate-checked plans for coding agents: brainstorm a design, write a plan whose stages end in runnable checks, execute it Red-Green with honest gates and code review, and keep a backlog and decisions. Works with no setup; records go to the repo's docs/.
